dmp.description: This Data Management Plan (DMP) describes the strategy for handling the data generated within the ELSAC (Early Life Stages of Antipatharian Corals) project. It sets out the procedures for data collection, documentation, storage, preservation, and sharing, in line with the FAIR principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) and the requirements of Horizon Europe and OpenAIRE. The DMP ensures that data produced in the project will be managed responsibly, remain accessible in the long term, and be shared whenever possible to maximize scientific and societal impact. It will be updated regularly to reflect the evolution of the project and the datasets generated.
